about: Who the Rainbow Bridge's (S3) people and animals are and what they do: every painted figure (232) and animal (9) of S3 (map/text/S3.md, u 15500-20500) at its mapped spot (layout.json, with its recorded moves), and nobody else (map/BUILDING.md). Written by gen/sections/rainbow_bridge/make_people.py from the cast gen/sections/rainbow_bridge/cast.json (the needs list's casting with the catalogue's new characters), at the kits' real sizes (the bridge as kit_rainbow_bridge fits it, the vehicles, the animals, the props); rerun it after a layout move, a build or a workshop delivery. figures: character (a character not made yet plays its stand_in; a figure painted seated, crouching or riding whose character lacks that posture is played by the nearest look that has it: cast_why), do = [clip, seconds] cycles with clips the playing character has (clips_why: what is still to make), nudge = [dX, dD] (nudge_why), facing_deg where the real-size scene needs another (facing_why), scale for children (scale_why), ride = the animal a rider sits on, props = carried prop_<name> parts (props_why). Crew on boats (layout support boat deck:/roof:/bow deck:) stand at their layout spots, placed by the page's boats (web/src/boats.js); boats: each boat's motion and crew work (the river agent's people_boats.json, merged). walkers: figures painted walking or carrying, along their painted direction and back (walkers_why). animals: each painted animal at its map position facing hind to fore, model, load and clips from web/public/assets/animals/animals.json (animals_why). Seats the map lacks: gen/sections/rainbow_bridge/seats.json, for the builder. No traffic.
